paragraphs: At Graphcore you will build the software that validates Graphcore’s machine learning stack, from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware. You will design production‑quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. You will architect test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not merely add tests to existing systems, allowing you to influence how the ML stack is validated across the full stack.

I have a strong focus on testing, having applied systematic evaluation to verify complex data pipelines and ensure correctness. In a separate project I combined omics and graph techniques to analyse large‑scale biological datasets, processing 1,399 cell lines × 16,385 genes, reducing RAM usage from 8.2 GB to 5.5 GB and achieving a train Pearson of 0.807 versus test Pearson of 0.545. Both experiences demonstrate my ability to construct reliable, reproducible test suites that surface issues early and provide clear evidence of numerical accuracy, directly aligning with Graphcore’s need for rigorous ML stack validation.

I bring proven production expertise, having built end‑to‑end fintech APIs that operate reliably under heavy load and integrate with existing services. I also containerised critical workloads using Docker, deployed them on AWS Lambda and managed access through IAM policies, ensuring secure execution in cloud environments. These capabilities equip me to deliver the production‑grade software Graphcore requires for its ML QA pipelines, supporting continuous integration and automated testing across diverse hardware targets.
